horizon_plugin.h and horizon_imgui.h: the Horizon Host plugin ABI 1.4 (MIT, see LICENSE),
copied from horizon-host branch release-0.3.1 (host 0.3.1). 1.3 = open_page, toasts, bridge and
post_present; 1.4 = ui_metrics (menu size, content scale, the room of the container a page is drawn
in). Copy them again when the ABI grows.
